mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS step_id, s.card_id AS card_id, COALESCE(c.key_facts, '[]'::jsonb)::text AS key_facts_json, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', k.name, 'aliases', k.aliases) ORDER BY t.ord), '[]'::json)::text FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(s.answer -> 'chain', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(id, ord) JOIN concepts k ON k.id = t.id) AS chain_json, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', k.name, 'aliases', k.aliases) ORDER BY t.ord), '[]'::json)::text FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(s.answer -> 'counter', '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(id, ord) JOIN concepts k ON k.id = t.id) AS counter_json, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(s.answer -> 'chain', '[]'::jsonb))) AS concept_ids FROM steps s JOIN cards c ON c.id = s.card_id WHERE s.id = #{stepId} AND s.kind = 'judgement'
SELECT count(*) FROM user_answers ua JOIN steps s ON s.id = ua.step_id WHERE ua.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND s.kind = 'judgement' AND ua.created_at >= #{since}

SELECT score, (rubric ->> 'evidence')::int AS evidence, (rubric ->> 'reasoning')::int AS reasoning, (rubric ->> 'rebuttal')::int AS rebuttal, graded_by, feedback FROM user_answers WHERE step_id = #{stepId} AND answer_hash = #{answerHash} AND graded_by = 'llm' AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO user_answers (user_id, card_id, step_id, answer, answer_hash, is_correct, score, rubric, graded_by, feedback) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{cardId}, #{stepId}, jsonb_build_object('choice', CAST(#{choice} AS text), 'text', CAST(#{answer} AS text)), #{answerHash}, #{isCorrect}, #{score},
jsonb_build_object('evidence', #{rubric.evidence}, 'reasoning', #{rubric.reasoning}, 'rebuttal', #{rubric.rebuttal}),
NULL,
#{gradedBy}, #{feedback})
